home.title: Your home feed
home.p1: See thank-yous, badges and news from across the company.
home.p2: Tap “Recognize someone” to thank a teammate. It takes about 30 seconds.
home.p3: Tap 👏 to applaud a post, or the speech bubble to comment.
home.p4: Add up to 4 photos to a thank-you. Tap any photo to see it full screen.
home.p5: Your level card shows your points and how many you can still give this month.
people.title: Finding people
people.p1: Search by name or job title, or tap a department.
people.p2: Open someone’s profile to see their badges and thank them.
badges.title: How badges work
badges.p1: Badges celebrate specific kinds of great work.
badges.p2: Tap a badge to see how to earn it and who already has it.
badges.p3: Managers award badges, and some can be added to a thank-you.
badges.p4: Every badge adds points to your total.
rewards.title: Spending your points
rewards.p1: Points you receive can be spent here.
rewards.p2: When you redeem, the points are held until HR approves. You can cancel any time before that.
rewards.p3: If HR declines, the points come straight back.
rewards.p4: Spending points never lowers your level.
wall.title: Memory Wall
wall.p1: A polaroid for every moment of your year, one string per month.
wall.p2: Thank-yous, badges, level-ups, birthdays, work anniversaries and rewards are pinned automatically.
wall.p3: Use Pin a Moment to add a skill you learned, a certification or an achievement — with a photo if you like.
wall.p4: Managers can pin moments for their team; HR and the Super Admin for anyone.
wall.p5: Everyone shows the company’s highlights. Switch the year to look back.
wall.p6: On this day: on dates with memories from earlier years you get a reminder, and Home shows them — share one again with a tap.
leaderboard.title: The leaderboard
leaderboard.p1: Shows who received the most points in the period you pick.
leaderboard.p2: Use the department chips to see your own team’s board.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.p1: You’re told when someone thanks you, comments, awards a badge or decides on a reward.
notifications.p2: Tap one to go straight to it.
team.title: Looking after your team
team.p1: See who has given and received recognition in the last 30 days.
team.p2: “Quiet” means they haven’t thanked anyone yet this month.
team.p3: Nudge sends them a friendly reminder (once a week at most).
team.p4: Recognize or award a badge right from each row.
admin-overview.title: Reading the overview
admin-overview.p1: Participation is the share of people who gave or received recognition in 30 days.
admin-overview.p2: “Not yet involved” lists people worth a personal nudge.
admin-users.title: Managing people
admin-users.p1: Tap Edit to change any detail: name, email, job title, employee ID, phone, birthday, joining date, team and role.
admin-users.p2: Birthdays and joining dates drive the automatic birthday and anniversary points.
admin-users.p3: Switch someone off to stop them signing in. Their history stays.
admin-users.p4: Inviting creates the account and shows a one-time password to share.
admin-roles.title: Roles and permissions
admin-roles.p1: A role is a set of switches that decide what people can see and do.
admin-roles.p2: Turn a switch on or off and it saves immediately. Use Undo if you change your mind.
admin-roles.p3: Compare shows every role side by side.
admin-roles.p4: Super Admin always keeps every permission, so you can’t lock yourself out.
admin-levels.title: Levels
admin-levels.p1: Levels come from points received over all time.
admin-levels.p2: Change where each level starts. The bar above shows how many people would land in each.
admin-badges.title: Badge Studio
admin-badges.p1: Create a badge: name it, say how to earn it, pick an icon and colour.
admin-badges.p2: New badges appear for everyone right away.
admin-badges.p3: Retire a badge to hide it. People who earned it keep it on their profile.
admin-rewards.title: Reward approvals
admin-rewards.p1: Only HR and the Super Admin decide reward requests.
admin-rewards.p2: Approve or decline requests. Declining refunds the points automatically.
admin-rewards.p3: Catalogue lets you add rewards or switch them off.
admin-moderation.title: Moderation
admin-moderation.p1: Reported posts land here. Keep the post or hide it from the feed.
admin-moderation.p2: You can restore hidden posts any time.
admin-settings.title: Company settings
admin-settings.p1: Company values are the reasons people pick when they say thank you.
admin-points.title: Points Rules
admin-points.p1: Only the Super Admin can see this page and change these amounts.
admin-points.p2: Points per appreciation are given automatically to everyone thanked — people don’t pick an amount.
admin-points.p3: Birthday, work anniversary and welcome bonuses are paid by the app on the day, once each.
admin-points.p4: Changes apply to everyone as soon as you save, and are written to the Audit Log.
admin-audit.title: Audit log
admin-audit.p1: A permanent record of who changed roles, people, rewards and settings.
settings.title: Your settings
settings.p1: Update your profile, appearance and password.
settings.p2: “Your access” lists what your role lets you do.
